title: actor.revoke_token — Request
description: Invalidate the active credential for the given actor. Idempotent via operation_id; revoking an already-revoked actor returns the same response shape (no error). Implementations MUST guard against revoking the last active human credential and MUST return error code `last_admin_protected` (HTTP 409) in that case — the system requires at least one human able to authenticate.

operation_id.description: UUIDv7. Same operation_id replays the cached response. Same operation_id with a different request body returns 409 Conflict.
